pairs: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Thus says the Lord God:
Porta atrii interioris quæ respicit ad orientem, erit clausa sex diebus in quibus opus fit:
“The gate of the inner court which looks toward the east shall be closed for the six days on which work is done. Then,
die autem sabbati aperietur,
on the Sabbath day, it shall be opened.
sed et in die calendarum aperietur.
But also on the day of the new moon, it shall be opened.
Et intrabit princeps per viam vestibuli portæ deforis,
And the prince shall enter from outside,
et stabit in limine portæ:
by the way of the vestibule of the gate,
et facient sacerdotes holocaustum ejus,
and he shall stand at the threshold of the gate.
et pacifica ejus:
And the priests shall offer his holocaust and his peace offerings.
et adorabit super limen portæ,
And he shall adore upon the threshold of the gate,
et egredietur:
and then depart.
porta autem non claudetur usque ad vesperam.
But the gate shall not be closed until evening.
Et adorabit populus terræ ad ostium portæ illius in sabbatis et in calendis coram Domino.
And the people of the land shall adore at the entrance of the same gate, on the Sabbaths and on the new moons, in the sight of the Lord.
Holocaustum autem hoc offeret princeps Domino:
Now this holocaust,
in die sabbati,
which the prince shall offer to the Lord on the Sabbath day,
sex agnos immaculatos,
shall be six immaculate lambs,
et arietem immaculatum,
and one immaculate ram.
et sacrificium ephi per arietem,
The sacrifice shall be one ephah for each ram.
in agnis autem sacrificium quod dederit manus ejus,
But for the lambs, the sacrifice shall be whatever his hand shall give.
et olei hin per singula ephi.
And there shall be one hin of oil for each ephah.
In die autem calendarum vitulum de armento immaculatum,
Then, on the day of the new moon, he shall offer one immaculate calf from the herd.
et sex agni et arietes immaculati erunt.
Both the six lambs and the rams shall be immaculate.
Et ephi per vitulum, ephi quoque per arietem faciet sacrificium:
And he shall offer the sacrifice of one ephah for each calf, and also one ephah for each ram.
de agnis autem sicut invenerit manus ejus,
But for the lambs, it shall be just as his hand will find.
et olei hin per singula ephi.
And there shall be one hin of oil for each ephah.
Cumque ingressurus est princeps,
And when the prince will enter,
per viam vestibuli portæ ingrediatur,
let him enter by the way of the vestibule of the gate,
et per eamdem viam exeat.
and let him go out by the same way.
Et cum intrabit populus terræ in conspectu Domini in solemnitatibus,
And when the people of the land will enter in the sight of the Lord on the solemnities,
qui ingreditur per portam aquilonis ut adoret,
whoever enters by the north gate so that he may adore,
egrediatur per viam portæ meridianæ:
shall depart by the way of the south gate.
porro qui ingreditur per viam portæ meridianæ,
And whoever enters by the way of the south gate shall depart by the way of the north gate.
egrediatur per viam portæ aquilonis.
He shall not return by way of the gate through which he entered.
Non revertetur per viam portæ per quam ingressus est,
Instead,
sed e regione illius egredietur.
he shall depart from the direction opposite to it.
Princeps autem in medio eorum cum ingredientibus ingredietur,
But the prince in their midst shall enter when they enter,
et cum egredientibus egredietur.
and he shall depart when they depart.
Et in nundinis,
And during the feasts and the solemnities,
et in solemnitatibus,
there shall be the sacrifice of one ephah for each calf,
erit sacrificium ephi per vitulum,
and one ephah for each ram.
et ephi per arietem:
But for the lambs,
agnis autem erit sacrificium sicut invenerit manus ejus,
the sacrifice shall be just as his hand will find.
et olei hin per singula ephi.
And there shall be one hin of oil for each ephah.
Cum autem fecerit princeps spontaneum holocaustum, aut pacifica voluntaria Domino,
But when the prince will offer a voluntary holocaust or a voluntary peace offering to the Lord,
aperietur ei porta quæ respicit ad orientem,
the gate which looks toward the east shall be opened to him.
et faciet holocaustum suum et pacifica sua,
And he shall offer his holocaust and his peace offerings,
sicut fieri solet in die sabbati:
just as is usually done on the Sabbath day.
et egredietur,
And he shall depart,
claudeturque porta postquam exierit.
and the gate shall be closed after he has gone out.
Et agnum ejusdem anni immaculatum faciet holocaustum quotidie Domino:
And daily he shall offer, as a holocaust to the Lord, an immaculate lamb of the same age.
semper mane faciet illud.
He shall offer it always in the morning.
Et faciet sacrificium super eo cata mane mane sextam partem ephi,
And he shall offer as a sacrifice with it, morning after morning, one sixth part of an ephah,
et de oleo tertiam partem hin,
and one third part of a hin of oil,
ut misceatur similæ:
to be mixed with the fine flour,
sacrificium Domino legitimum, juge atque perpetuum.
as a sacrifice to the Lord, by a continual and everlasting ordinance.
Faciet agnum, et sacrificium,
He shall offer the lamb and the sacrifice and the oil,
et oleum cata mane mane,
morning after morning,
holocaustum sempiternum.
as an everlasting holocaust.
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Thus says the Lord God:
Si dederit princeps donum alicui de filiis suis,
If the prince grants a gift to any of his sons,
hæreditas ejus filiorum suorum erit:
the inheritance of it will go to his sons;
possidebunt eam hæreditarie.
they shall possess it as an inheritance.
Si autem dederit legatum de hæreditate sua uni servorum suorum,
But if he grants a legacy from his inheritance to one of his servants,
erit illius usque ad annum remissionis,
it shall be his only until the year of remission,
et revertetur ad principem:
and then it shall be returned to the prince.
hæreditas autem ejus filiis ejus erit.
For his inheritance shall go to his sons.
Et non accipiet princeps de hæreditate populi per violentiam,
And the prince shall not take from the inheritance of the people by force,
et de possessione eorum:
nor from their possession. Instead,
sed de possessione sua hæreditatem dabit filiis suis,
from his own possession, he shall give an inheritance to his sons,
ut non dispergatur populus meus unusquisque a possessione sua.
so that my people will not be scattered, each one from his possession.”
Et introduxit me per ingressum qui erat ex latere portæ,
And he led me in by the entrance which was at the side of the gate,
in gazophylacia sanctuarii ad sacerdotes,
into the storerooms of the sanctuary for the priests,
quæ respiciebant ad aquilonem:
which looked toward the north.
et erat ibi locus vergens ad occidentem.
And there was a place there which verged toward the west.
Et dixit ad me:
And he said to me:
Iste est locus ubi coquent sacerdotes pro peccato
“This is the place where the priests will cook the offering for sin and the offering for trespasses.
et pro delicto:
Here,
ubi coquent sacrificium,
they shall cook the sacrifice,
ut non efferant in atrium exterius,
so that they need not carry it to the outer court,
et sanctificetur populus.
and so that the people may be sanctified.”
Et eduxit me in atrium exterius,
And he led me away to the outer court,
et circumduxit me per quatuor angulos atrii:
and he led me around by the four corners of the court. And behold,
et ecce atriolum erat in angulo atrii,
there was a little atrium at the corner of the court;
atriola singula per angulos atrii.
a little atrium was at each corner of the court.
In quatuor angulis atrii atriola disposita,
At the four corners of the court, little atriums were positioned,
quadraginta cubitorum per longum,
forty cubits in length, and thirty in width;
et triginta per latum: mensuræ unius quatuor erant.
each of the four were of the same measure.
Et paries per circuitum ambiens quatuor atriola:
And there was a wall all around, encircling the four little atriums.
et culinæ fabricatæ erant subter porticus per gyrum.
And kitchens had been constructed under the porticos on all sides.
Et dixit ad me:
And he said to me:
Hæc est domus culinarum,
“This is the house of the kitchens,
in qua coquent ministri domus Domini victimas populi.
in which the ministers of the house of the Lord will cook the victims of the people.”
